props.title: Meghan Clarisse
props.face: Covers and originals, solo, as a duo or with a full band.
props.lede: You know what it’s like when Jolene comes on and the whole table starts singing along? Meghan Clarisse is a Denver singer-songwriter who calls what she does “music with country roots and cowgirl boots,” and she plays the country songs your guests love alongside her own. She can play on her own at a dinner, bring pedal steel or electric guitar as a duo, or bring a five-piece band to get people dancing.
props.headingNote: Here’s how booking through Signet works.

props.title: Meghan Clarisse and her band playing her song Fire and Fly live

props.html: Meghan’s album Shadows of a Ghost Town won the 2026 Josie Music Award for Folk/Americana Album of the Year. The Colorado Country Music Hall of Fame gave her its Golden Star Award in 2026, and her duo won its Duo of the Year award in 2025. You may have seen her on Great Day Colorado or Colorado & Company, too.
Her usual style is a little vintage cowgirl, and that’s a lot of fun if you want a country feel. If your event is more formal, she can dress up or wear all black, too.
When she’s not performing, Meghan volunteers with Musicians On Call, playing live music for patients at Children’s Hospital and the VA in Denver.

props.title: Configurations
props.note: Send us your date and we’ll help you choose the size that works best. She can put a trio together, too, if that’s a better fit.

rows.text: Book her solo or as a duo for your ceremony or cocktail hour, and bring in the five-piece band for the reception.
She’s a lot of fun at a birthday or an anniversary when your guests love country music, and a solo or a duo is an easy fit at home.
Dolly Parton and Fleetwood Mac both go over well with a mixed crowd. Book the five-piece band if you want a dance floor, or the duo if your party is more of a dinner.
If your team is flying in from out of state, a Colorado songwriter with a pedal steel player beside her is a fun way to welcome them to the West.

props.html: Planning toasts or a program? We can work the music around them with your run of show. You can also get a general idea of what live music costs in Colorado from our cost guide.

items.q: Does she play covers or her own songs?
items.a: She plays both. Her song list mixes crowd-pleasing covers with her own songs, and we’ll work out the balance with you.

items.q: Can she keep the volume down during dinner?
items.a: Yes. On her own or as a duo, she can play at a level where nobody has to raise their voice. The five-piece band is louder, and if your venue has a sound limit, just let us know.
Yes. She plays festivals and farmers markets along the Front Range, so an outdoor wedding or a company picnic is a comfortable fit.
Yes, she plays up and down the Front Range. Tell us where your event is and we’ll let you know what’s possible.
